reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 455 for this 1820-receiver graph. Lower bound is an independent set of size 455 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_2 whose length meets 455, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. Only 1 code was tried and the bracket closed from [455, 529] after 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round. Wall time 102.872 s, of which compute_s 90.453 s (mostly the initial describe step), llm_s 12.419 s, warmup 1.597 s. Baselines were not run, so no accuracy or time comparison can be claimed. Nothing suspicious: the hypothesis gave no explicit params, but the certificate is independent of it.
